content: Backend: Support up to 5 headlines & 5 primary texts per ad (arrays with backward compat)
Backend: Split editor upload & submit - upload no longer auto-transitions; new /editor/submit endpoint
Frontend: Rewrite Create Ad Set flow - one ad at a time with tabs, + button, Submit at top
Frontend: Editor Ad Detail - brief prominently displayed (script/guidelines/refs/media) + upload + separate Submit
Frontend: Update AdDetailBody and Downloads to render arrays of headlines/primary texts
Frontend: Update Kanban drop flow to align with new upload-then-submit semantic
Testing agent E2E on all 4 changes
